input.prompt: Documentary-style photograph of an elderly fisherman mending a fishing net on a weathered wooden pier at early morning. He sits on an upturned wooden crate, weathered hands working through a tangle of brown and grey netting, a needle and twine in his fingers. Deep wrinkles, a sun-worn face, a faded wool cap and a thick cable-knit sweater. Coils of net and frayed rope lie around his boots on the planks, with a few buoys and a wooden fish box nearby. Behind him, a calm grey harbour with moored fishing boats and soft fog over the water. Natural, unposed composition, shot at eye level with a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft diffused overcast daylight, muted earthy color palette, authentic photojournalistic realism, subtle film grain.
